Deputies performed CPR, and EMS pronounced her dead at the scene. Walker left in another vehicle and left the SUV in the parking lot. Deputies found her at a nearby residence and arrested her. She is charged with failure to stop and render aid. Deputies said she showed no signs of intoxication and was cooperating. Investigators are also looking at the person who picked her up.

title: William "Frank" Mays killed in Ohio City bike lane
summary: William "Frank" Mays, 35, of Highland Hills, was killed about 4:50 p.m. on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026, while riding in the marked bike lane near Detroit Avenue and West 25th Street in Ohio City, Cleveland. The Cuyahoga County Prosecutor's Office said Tyrelle Taylor, 26, was fleeing Cleveland police in a 2010 Ford F-150 Raptor when a front wheel broke off. Taylor kept going on three wheels, struck Mays, and lodged him in the wheel well. Taylor dragged him about 0.4 mile before crashing at the West 28th Street and Franklin Boulevard roundabout. Taylor fled on foot and turned himself in on Oct. 21. A grand jury indicted him on Oct. 30 for murder, involuntary manslaughter, 19 counts of felonious assault, tampering with evidence, two counts of failure to comply with a police order, and nine counts of failure to stop after an accident. Mays died at the hospital about 90 minutes after he was struck.
